metadata.title: [Bugfix][Loader] Skip the embedding, final norm, LM head and encoder towers a pipeline stage does not hold
metadata.body:
## Purpose

Under pipeline parallelism the default loader already leaves out the decoder layers of other stages before it reads them (DefaultModelLoader._skip_weight_for with decoder_layer_filter). The modules around the decoder stack that a stage does not hold were still read: PPMissingLayer stands for the embedding on every stage but the first, and for the final norm and the LM head on every stage but the last. The loader memory-mapped those tensors, handed them through the model's weight transforms, and only then did the model drop them.

How much that costs depends on the transforms. On main it is reads: with GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 at PP5, every middle stage touches the BF16 embedding (1210 MiB) and the MXFP8 LM head (605 MiB) for nothing. Together with the MXFP8 weight pairing of #1286, four stages of five also dequantized the whole LM head ([154880, 4096]) to BF16 on the CPU, about 6 GiB each with the fp32 intermediates, and threw it away. On our host with 30.7 GiB of RAM, swap grew by 11.1 to 15.5 GB during each of the five GLM boots we checked. A per-second host memory trace of one boot showed the three middle stages sitting about three and a half minutes on the shard that holds the LM head, at about 7 GiB of anonymous memory each.

Change:
- direct_io.missing_module_filter(stack_modules, language_model_modules) matches tensors by position. Children of the decoder stack use the same checkpoint prefixes as the decoder layer filter ("", "model.", "model.language_model.", "language_model.model."); these prefixes are now one constant shared by both filters. Children of the language model use "" or "language_model.".
- default_loader._missing_module_filter collects the PPMissingLayer children of the partial decoder stack and of the language model root. _skip_weight_for adds this filter next to the decoder layer filter, for the same strategies (default and direct). _partial_decoder_stacks is factored out of _pipeline_stage_layer_range, so both use the same stack search.
- A stage that keeps a real module reads it as before, for example the DFlash embedding replica on GLM-5.3's last stage or a tied embedding. A checkpoint whose names differ from the module names is not matched and loads unchanged; DeepSeek-V4 stores embed/head and only norm.weight matches there. The stage logs which modules it skips.

Second commit, encoder towers: a multimodal model builds a tower as StageMissingLayer when --limit-mm-per-prompt disables all of its modalities, and, once vllm-project/vllm#60238 is ported (#1365), on the stages after the first under Model Runner V2. Under pipeline parallelism the loader still read such a tower and ran it through the weight transforms; with GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local every stage read the 372.5 MiB tower. _missing_module_filter now also collects the PPMissingLayer and StageMissingLayer children of the multimodal model, matched at the prefixes "" and "model." (model.visual., visual.), and treats StageMissingLayer children of the decoder stack and the language model like PPMissingLayer ones. missing_module_filter takes the multimodal names as a third argument.

Not a duplicate: I searched the open PRs for PPMissingLayer, "pipeline stage skip", "lm_head pipeline loader", skip_checkpoint_weight, "direct I/O pipeline" and "embed_tokens pipeline parallel load", for the second commit also StageMissingLayer, "StageMissingLayer loader", "encoder tower pipeline", "vision tower loader" and "skip tower weights", and checked the file lists of all 104 open PRs again on 2026-11-05. Only #1356 changes default_loader.py, and only in _prepare_weights (missing shards); it does not touch _skip_weight_for, direct_io.py or the stage filters, and the two changes edit separate hunks.

AI assistance was used for this change. I reviewed every line and ran the tests and measurements below.

## Test Plan

python -m pytest tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_direct_io.py tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_safetensors_index_filter.py tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_ep_weight_filter.py tests/v1/spec_decode/test_eagle_weight_sharing.py tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark.py tests/models/test_mtp_skip_checkpoint_weight.py, one process per file.
pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD; pre-commit run mypy-3.10 --hook-stage manual --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD
New tests in test_direct_io.py: test_missing_module_filter_matches_only_the_named_modules (multimodal, Llama-style and DeepSeek-V4 names, decoder layers, MTP heads, vision towers and look-alike names stay), test_missing_module_filter_needs_a_module, test_missing_module_filter_matches_encoder_towers (model.visual. and visual. go, visual_proj and the language model stay), and test_missing_module_filter_follows_the_stage (first, middle and last stage, a last stage that keeps an embedding replica, a middle stage and a single stage without the tower).

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DefaultModelLoader._skip_weight_for, default and direct strategy | any safetensors | pipeline parallel size > 1, unambiguous decoder stack | tensors of PPMissingLayer stack and language-model children skipped before reading | executed: test_direct_io.py; measured: GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 PP5 A/B/A/B and control run on our fork | other PP models: not booted with this change |
| same, without pipeline parallelism, or eager/prefetch/torchao | any | pipeline parallel size 1 or other strategy | unchanged (no filter) | source | none |
| checkpoints whose module names differ from the model (DeepSeek-V4 embed/head) | any | PP | not matched, loaded as before (DeepSeek-V4: norm.weight skipped on stages without the norm) | source, test names | DeepSeek-V4 not booted with this change |
| encoder towers built as StageMissingLayer (second commit) | any safetensors | PP, tower disabled by --limit-mm-per-prompt or (with vllm#60238) a later stage under V2 | tower tensors skipped before reading | executed: test_direct_io.py; fork: GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local PP5 with its image part, stages 1 to 4 log "multimodal model ['visual']" in every boot since 2026-11-05 | not measured on its own; other multimodal PP models not booted |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: always on under pipeline parallelism with the default or direct strategy.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: none.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: fp8_e4m3 (GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MTP, DFlash k=7, PP5 over 3x V100 + 2x RTX 8000, --safetensors-load-strategy direct).
- Wheel SHA or source commit: written and verified on a fork build (github.com/Peuqui/1Cat-vLLM, f0a168c29 on top of our integration branch with #1286; second commit c47e6e5d2 on the branch glm-vision-pp, in our GLM-5.3 production since 2026-11-05); this branch is the same patches on main b2b6b3bb9, unit-tested there.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: fork tree on PYTHONPATH for the boots; none for the tests.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: A/B/A/B of the production entry, T (with the change) against P (without), five boots T T P T P, page cache of both checkpoints dropped before every boot, the first T boot not counted. Weight loading on stage 0: 192.6 / 192.3 s against 263.1 / 258.6 s. Server ready after 301 / 306 s against 397 / 346 s. Peak swap of the service cgroup during the boot: 5.00 / 4.68 GiB against 14.94 / 10.66 GiB. Prefill of 8687 tokens: 4.28 / 4.25 s against 4.26 / 4.40 s. Short decode: 41.82 / 41.82 tok/s against 41.81 / 41.80 tok/s. GSM8K-30: 29 / 29 against 29 / 29, acceptance length 5.430 in every arm. Decode at 516196 tokens of context: 95.1 / 93.8 ms per step against 96.0 / 92.3. Peak GPU memory per card: equal within 2 MiB. KV cache size: 676,645 tokens in every arm. Eight quality answers (1500 tokens each): identical text between the first T and the first P arm. These numbers are for the first commit; the second one was not measured on its own (it saves one 372.5 MiB read per stage that does not build the tower).
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: not touched.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no setting added or changed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: none; the LoadConfig docstring change keeps its line count, so the generated architecture reference stays valid.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: no change.

## Test Result

Tests on main b2b6b3bb9 with both commits, one process per file:
- tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_direct_io.py: 33 passed (CPU)
- tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_safetensors_index_filter.py: 14 passed (CPU)
- tests/model_executor/model_loader/test_ep_weight_filter.py: 36 passed (CPU)
- tests/v1/spec_decode/test_eagle_weight_sharing.py: 8 passed (CPU)
- tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark.py: 15 passed (CPU)
- tests/models/test_mtp_skip_checkpoint_weight.py: 13 passed (one GPU)
pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD: every hook passes except check-layering, which reports vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py (platform coupling 37 -> 39); this PR does not touch that file, which is identical to main b2b6b3bb9. pre-commit run mypy-3.10 --hook-stage manual: passed.
